name: OIDC-Auth
description: Advanced OIDC authentication with role-based library access control
overview: OpenID Connect SSO with granular role-to-library mapping, multi-provider support, and a full admin configuration UI.
changelog: Security release. Fixes: an SSO identity on a second provider (or SAML) could be bound into an existing account, admins included; disabled accounts could still sign in via SSO and approve Quick Connect; SAML had no login-CSRF binding and accepted a signed Response wrapped in an unsigned one; two Require-SSO admin-exemption bypasses; SSO broke on servers with a base URL. BEHAVIOUR CHANGES: a login matching no role mapping now strips permissions when RBAC is in use (the hourly re-sync applies this to stored users within about an hour of upgrading, so set a Default Role first if needed); pre-authorized users need a matching username; transient SAML NameIDs are rejected; the unusable account-link API is removed. See MIGRATION.md.
